en: I have decided to follow Jesus
No turning back, no turning bac
Though none go with me, still I will follow
No turning back, no turning back
My cross I'll carry, till I see Jesus
No turning back, no turning back

ko: 어떠한 시련이 와도 수많은 유혹 속에도
en: Even if trials come,even in the midst of countless temptations,I will hold on to the faithful Lord’s promise.
Though the world may not understand and may mock us, I will hold on only to the faithful Lord’s promise I will never turn back
